title: Ad Tracking & Targeted Advertising Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Professional letter template to request information about ad tracking practices and opt-out of targeted advertising from companies.
description: A comprehensive letter template to formally request details about how companies track your online behavior for advertising purposes and request removal from targeted advertising programs. Perfect for asserting your privacy rights.

sections.heading: Letter Header and Contact Information
sections.content: Begin your letter with proper formatting including your contact details and the company's information. This establishes a formal communication record.

sections.heading: Subject Line and Opening Statement
sections.content: Clearly state the purpose of your letter with a direct subject line. Open with a polite but firm statement about your privacy concerns regarding ad tracking practices.

sections.heading: Information Request About Tracking Practices
sections.content: Request specific details about what data is collected, how it's used for advertising, and what third parties have access. This section exercises your right to know how your data is being processed.

placeholders.label: Specific Tracking Concerns
placeholders.defaultValue: [Describe any specific tracking behavior you've noticed]

sections.heading: Opt-Out Requests
sections.content: Formally request to be removed from targeted advertising programs, behavioral profiling, and cross-site tracking. Specify that you want the most restrictive privacy settings applied to your account.

sections.heading: Third-Party Data Sharing Concerns
sections.content: Address data sharing with advertising partners, data brokers, and other third parties. Request that your information not be shared for advertising purposes and ask for a list of current data sharing partnerships.

placeholders.label: Known Advertising Partners (if any)
placeholders.defaultValue: [List any known advertising partners if applicable]

sections.heading: Timeline and Response Expectations
sections.content: Set clear expectations for response time and specify the format you prefer for their reply. Reference relevant privacy laws that may apply to your request.

placeholders.label: Applicable Privacy Laws
placeholders.defaultValue: [CCPA, GDPR, or other relevant privacy laws]

sections.heading: Closing and Next Steps
sections.content: Conclude professionally while maintaining firmness about your privacy rights. Include your contact information for follow-up and mention potential escalation if the company doesn't respond appropriately.

useCases: Requesting Facebook or Google to stop personalized ad targeting
Asking e-commerce sites to explain their retargeting practices
Demanding removal from data broker advertising profiles
Exercising CCPA or GDPR rights regarding advertising data
